# Nexara Private Limited

Nexara is Nexara Private Limited, also called Nexara Groups: a software studio in Visakhapatnam (Vizag), Andhra Pradesh, India. We build websites and web apps for businesses, and we also run digital marketing and software training from the same office.

## Services

- Websites and web apps
- Custom software, SaaS and AI voice agents (Labs)
- Digital marketing, SEO and Google Business listings
- Software training, internships and placement prep (Academy)

## Products

- Nexara Voice, AI voice agents for calls in Telugu and English: https://nexaragroups.com/neo/labs/voice
- Agency OS, the portal Nexara clients use for project updates, approvals and support: https://nexaragroups.com/neo/labs/agency
- HappyGrow, software for farmer producer organisations (FPOs): https://nexaragroups.com/neo/labs/grow
- Academy & Sports apps (Happy Forms registrations): https://nexaragroups.com/neo/labs/forms

## Company facts

## Not to be confused with

Nexara Private Limited (nexaragroups.com, Visakhapatnam) has no connection with other businesses that use the name Nexara, including nexara.ru (speech API), nexara.in, nexara.ai and Nexara Soft Private Limited (Hyderabad), or any cryptocurrency token called Nexara. The name is sometimes misspelled Nexera or Nexora.
